bulletin.text:
Satellites detected 346 Priority 1 fires, 240 Priority 2 fires and 0 Priority 3 fires across West Kalimantan on 18 September 2026. The top ten fires account for 34% of all modelled smoke over residents from West Kalimantan fires.

The leading fire is near Ketapang, with 5.9% of modelled smoke over residents. 2,612,824 residents live within 40 km of its smoke path. Its smoke is heading NW and reaches Kubu Raya in 7 hours; Kubu Raya receives 35% of that fire's smoke over residents, Kota Pontianak 25%, and Ketapang 20%. The second-ranked fire is near Kayong Utara, with 5.6% of modelled smoke over residents. 2,686,595 residents live within 40 km of its smoke path. Its smoke is heading NW and reaches Kubu Raya in 2 hours; Kubu Raya receives 47%, Kota Pontianak 26%, and Kayong Utara 10%.

Since the previous day, 4 fires left the top ten, and new entries appeared near Kayong Utara and Ketapang. This is a ranking index, not a forecast of smoke concentration. People outside Indonesia are not counted. The task force decides.
